title: Team capacity allocation
description: One hundred outlined blocks make whole-percent shares countable. A bold categorical key names every allocation.

props.name: data
props.description: Categories with unique nonempty id, label, whole-number percent or null, and optional tone a–d. Requires complete percentages summing to exactly 100; invalid, missing, fractional and all-zero allocations show an explicit state. Zero-share categories retain their key entries. Blocks follow caller order and colors remain stable by ID. Each category is one keyboard stop.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned measurement or allocation label. Defaults to Value, or Share for Hundred Blocks.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional reporting period or other caller-owned context.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels; otherwise content determines height. Dense plots scroll locally.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable finite native Recharts motion subject to the language tokens and reduced motion.
